bioconda.name: bioconductor-biovizbase
bioconda.summary: Basic graphic utilities for visualization of genomic data.

biotools.summary: The biovizBase package is designed to provide a set of utilities, color schemes and conventions for genomic data. It serves as the base for various high-level packages for biological data visualization. This saves development effort and encourages consistency.
